content: RAI integrates Nav2 as an action-tool: the RAI Robot Control Agent in the arXiv paper example uses the nav2 stack for NavigateToPose-class goals combined with open-set object detection for referring to objects ('go near the chair'). A tracked bugfix ('reject non-finite NavigateToPose coordinates') confirms the tool posts real NavigateToPose action goals rather than raw cmd_vel for goal-directed navigation. Source: arxiv.org/html/2505.07532v1, github.com/RobotecAI/rai commit history.
